findings.what: Leave check (assertNotOnLeave) runs outside the insert transaction; a booking racing recordLeave can land as booked on a leave day.
Patient reschedule frees the old slot but does not offer it to the waitlist; only cancellation triggers offerFreedSlot.
Expiry sweep runs every 5 minutes, so an unaccepted offer passes to the next patient up to ~35 min after sending, not exactly 30.
acceptOffer claim, appointment creation and entry update are not in one transaction; relies on compensating writes, a crash mid-way leaves inconsistent state.
Offer email failure is only logged; the offer stays pending until expiry with no retry, wasting the slot window.
